title: Car fried by energy weapon en route to filming implant test
summary: Steve tells of Car fried by energy weapon en route to filming implant test, about unspecified at canyon on the way to Dr. builder's office, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: canyon on the way to Dr. builder's office

tellings.quote: [sighs and gasps] they um zapped my car with some kind of an energy weapon when I was um uh going to Dr. builder's office to um uh film um uh him um testing the implant while it was still in the body. And um uh the mechanic said later that the the computer in the car was fried like it was exposed to EMP or something.

plain: A man named Steve says that while he was driving through a canyon to a doctor's office to film the doctor testing an implant, a small object he says was placed inside a person's body, still in place, someone zapped his car with some kind of energy weapon. Steve says a mechanic later told him the car's computer was fried as if hit by an electromagnetic pulse, a burst of energy that knocks out electronics. He tells it because, if true, it would mean someone was trying to stop that test from being filmed.
